summary: security checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication boundaries, least privilege, secrets handling, container isolation, release provenance and approvals, dependency controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, and 10 unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, permit only bounded reversible growth within existing consent, disclosure, and data boundaries, and continue read-only evidence capture without credentials, private-container access, permission changes, dependency additions, deployment, exploitation, or external outreach.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated evidence, scope, owners, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for access boundaries, secrets, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data flows, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue failures, or conduct external outreach.
